cssProperties.description: Pressed state of a toggle button (see `selected`).
cssProperties.name: --c2-button__container__selected--background-color

slots.description: Icon shown before the label. Replaced by `running-icon` while the button is running.
slots.name: prefix-icon

slots.description: Icon shown in place of the prefix icon while `running` is set. Defaults to a spinner; the slot wrapper rotates, so slotted content spins too.
slots.name: running-icon

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables the button: it no longer receives clicks and is rendered dimmed.

members.name: running
members.description: Marks the button as busy: clicks are ignored and the `running-icon` slot replaces the prefix icon.

members.name: selected
members.description: Pressed state of a toggle button (`aria-pressed="true"`); styled with the `container__selected--*` variables.

members.name: toggle
members.description: Declares a toggle button: `aria-pressed` is announced as `false` while not selected. Set by `c2-button-group` in selection modes.
